local_results.argument: Cauchy condensation reduces the positive p=2 and p=3 series to geometric series with ratios 1/2 and 1/4.

Finite simple truncations increase to the countably valued variable; indicator expectation, finite linearity, and monotone convergence give the weighted extended series and its integrability consequence.
